title: From Local Concepts to Universals: Evaluating the Multicultural Understanding of Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the cultural diversity of retrieved images for universal concepts (like 'wedding' or 'breakfast') using an entropy-based metric (diversity@k), and measuring visual grounding accuracy (bounding box IoU) for culture-specific visual concepts to identify Western-centric representation and familiarity disparities.

Analyzing model performance and retrieval distributions across 50 countries and 10 global regions to detect systemic preferences and higher accuracy for images sourced from North America and Europe compared to non-Western regions.
